AnyList runtime package
=======================

anylist-0.8.6.tgz is produced with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` from
https://github.com/pomartel/anylist-js/tree/5cdd322d7c03d54ee047a44deca896f9037eea7d

It contains the protobuf 8 compatibility adapter and updated dependencies.
The archive is pinned locally to make deployments reproducible.
Regenerate it after changing the fork and rerun protocol and application tests.
